framework: AWS Security Best Practices + HackTricks Cloud AWS
description: CI/CD posture checks for CodeBuild token leakage and interception paths

items.title: CodeBuild source credentials configured (token leakage blast radius)
items.description: Configured source credentials can be abused to access external repos or leak OAuth/GitHub tokens under certain conditions.
items.remediation: Remove unused source credentials; prefer short-lived connections (CodeConnections) and least privilege; monitor CodeBuild credential usage.

pci_dss.reason: Secrets/credentials must be managed and protected to avoid unauthorized access.

items.title: CodeBuild project allows insecure SSL or proxy interception configuration
items.description: insecureSsl or attacker-controlled proxy settings can enable interception and token leakage.
items.remediation: Disable insecureSsl; restrict who can update CodeBuild project settings; prevent proxy env var injection; enforce egress controls.

pci_dss.reason: Protect public-facing components and CI/CD integrations to prevent compromise.

notes: Collector intentionally avoids persisting token material; only metadata is stored.
